# Copilot instructions

## Comments (must be consistent with surrounding files)
- Preserve existing comments and comment style (e.g., `/** */` vs `//`).
- Add the same level of documentation the surrounding code uses.
- Keep comments concise; avoid restating the code.

## Spacing/readability (must be consistent with surrounding files)
- Keep functions and logic separated with blank lines like adjacent code.
- Avoid overly long lines; wrap consistently with the file's style.
